svg.title: Workflow: Conversational analytics (sales & market data)
svg.desc: Solution workflow (conversational) for Conversational analytics (sales & market data): 1 trigger: Business user asks a question in natural language → request with persona; 2 guardrail: Persona access control and region/brand scope applied before any query → scoped request; 3 agent: Reads guidance, synonym map and field annotations; resolves metric and entities → query plan; 4 decision: Native text-to-SQL can see the custom fields? yes → step 5 / no → step 6; 5 skill: Generates and runs SQL over annotated objects → result set; 6 skill: Calls the domain query skill or cross-domain join skill → result set; 7 agent: Answers with table, period and scope using business labels, refusing schema enumeration and out-of-scope data → answer; 8 system: Logs tokens, cost and response time per query → cost and latency record; 9 human: QA reviewers score the harness run against ground truths computed outside the platform → pass rate; 10 outcome: Self-serve answers with consistency to certified reports and transparent cost (targets) → fewer analyst tickets
